model.name: Qwen3.8-27B
model.provenanceLimit: Cache revision refs are recorded; prepared local weights were not fully content-hashed.

limits: Single hardware configuration and one upstream revision; no release trend yet.
Synthetic dossiers and scripted tool observations; generated code and tests were not executed.
Serial inference with a loaded model; no concurrent-load or startup-latency benchmark.
Manual, non-blinded quality review; no population success rate or p95 estimate.
Exact repeats are a favorable cache condition, not a forecast for changing conversations.
Full prompts, transcripts and machine logs are excluded; this results-only package is not a standalone inference reproducer.

failures.detail: Initial FP8 startup could not link libcudart; CUDA wheel development symlinks were corrected before measurements.
A native tokenizer SIGSEGV occurred during dossier preparation. The process restarted; retained sources were resumed. Cause not established.
Speculative request metrics were incompatible with disabled speculation. The corrected profile retained ordinary timing metrics. Failed startup is excluded from inference counts.

quality.title: Payment repair
quality.finding: Invented a 27-hour expiry for uncertain payments; receipt reconciliation could repeat external side effects. Rollback instructions contradicted the writer guard.

quality.title: Incident recovery
quality.finding: Identified the incident facts, but stale charge/refund claims could be retried outside their idempotency window. Recovery transitions conflicted with worker guards.

quality.title: Migration design
quality.finding: Stopped mid-heading before tests and rollback. Persisted a mutable ctid cursor, lacked a transactional ownership fence, and aged unresolved conflicts into deletable rows.

quality.title: Pipeline audit
quality.finding: Offset advancement could loop indefinitely; rollback allowed unsafe ordering; repair invented event identities and did not enforce quarantine on ingestion.
